notice:
WINDOWS NATIVE SOURCE AND NOTICE COMPANION

This companion applies only to the exact wheels and native hashes in WINDOWS-RELEASE.json. Original wheels and their notices are preserved byte-for-byte. Each dependency retains its own terms; this is not a relicensing or a grant of rights absent from its upstream license.

pi-heif notice correction: its original LICENSES_bundled.txt points to older libheif1.18.1/libde2651.0.15. The actual locked Windows DLLs report libheif1.23.0 and libde2651.1.1; their complete corresponding source archives and the locked pi-heif Windows PKGBUILD are supplied under sources/. The original incorrect notice is retained for provenance rather than rewritten.

The bundled GCC runtime DLLs identify GCC16.1.0 MSYS2 Rev2/Rev5 compiler objects. Both official source/patch/build packages are supplied, including original GCC sources, with GPL3/GCC runtime-exception terms retained among third-party-notices and source files. Full winpthreads COPYING, including the mingw-w64 and derived Lockless copyright/permission/disclaimer text, is also supplied. Notice retrieval does not invent a DLL build-version identity.

PyMuPDF and MuPDF1.28.2 use the AGPL branch: full locked PyMuPDF and complete matching MuPDF sources/build material accompany the bundle. The full AGPL is LICENSE, and all corresponding-source copyrights and third-party notices remain in the supplied archives. Sources for the exact Vellric and MIT Conric revisions are included as well.

LGPL shared libraries remain separate DLLs. Recipients may rebuild, replace or relink them for modifications/debugging under their licenses. requirements-wheels.txt describes the qualified unmodified distribution; it is not a prohibition or technical lock on modified installations. A modified wheel needs its own correct RECORD and installation hashes; no signing key or secret is required by this distribution to make such a modified installation.

Other original license texts and build-specific SBOM/notice records are copied under third-party-notices/ without replacing the versions inside the wheels. The Microsoft runtime remains subject to its applicable Microsoft terms; neither this document, a manifest status nor a passing test supplies Visual Studio entitlement or redistribution permission. The operator confirmed existing approval of the established unchanged bundle/runtime for this release. That disposition and preserved research are recorded separately; no new Microsoft license or entitlement is asserted by this archive.
